title: Eliminate all type: ignore comments
description:
There are 8 type: ignore comments across the codebase that suppress real type errors instead of fixing them:

- leaderboard.py (2): sort key lambdas on dicts — would be fixed by using TypedDicts or dataclasses for model data
- blunder_analysis.py (2): Anthropic cache_control extension in OpenAI message format, and cached_tokens being int|None — could be fixed with proper casting or a typed wrapper
- scryfall.py (1): cache dict value type mismatch — would be fixed by tightening the cache type
- autoclaim-issue.py, claim-issue.py, finalize-issue-pr.py (3): identical subprocess.run wrapper using **kwargs: object — would be fixed by using proper keyword arguments instead of **kwargs

Each suppression hides a real type mismatch. Fix the underlying types so mypy can check these code paths.
